score_breakdown.reason: USD 148.66–648.37/month versus budget 500: fit 5 when upper bound fits, 3 when only lower fits, 1 within twice budget, otherwise 0. All selected services are included under disclosed assumptions.
Language familiarity 5.00/5 and implementation-complexity rubric 2.75/5; short delivery/beginner-complexity and manual Markdown-conversion penalties are explicit heuristics.
Static delivery avoids application writes; embedded-writer and growth triggers are ordinal review heuristics, not published capacity limits.
No latency SLA or measured framework throughput is credited; embedded-write concurrency is a review heuristic. Low-memory clients require measurement, not an assumed framework benchmark.
Operational burden 1/5+; no existing-system reuse bonus. Fewer self-operated systems are favored without DevOps. Additional service operating penalty 0.
Baseline configured controls: 3; explicit reviewed tenant isolation: 4. No certification/audit credit is assigned.

alternatives.why_not: A compatible plan tied on score; the published cost-upper-bound/operated-component/identifier tie-break selected the primary plan, not intrinsic product superiority.

backend.justification: Provides a python application runtime for the web_app profile. Language familiarity and delivery complexity were compared across compatible whole plans. Selected after supporting-service compatibility, data-flow/control checks and whole-plan cost scoring.
tradeoffs: Business features, authentication and compatible database drivers must be configured; the framework alone is not the application.

alternatives.why_not: No compatible complete plan with this different layer option survived the current reviewed constraints/edges. See candidate rejection trace; this is not proof that the product is inherently unsuitable.

database.justification: relational persistence via Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL.  Database drivers and host deployment were checked as a combination. Selected after supporting-service compatibility, data-flow/control checks and whole-plan cost scoring.
tradeoffs: Data model, backup policy, licensing and release/driver compatibility need explicit review.

alternatives.why_not: A compatible plan tied on score; the published cost-upper-bound/operated-component/identifier tie-break selected the primary plan, not intrinsic product superiority.

frontend.justification: Covers requested targets android with native rendering. Team languages: javascript, python. Selected after supporting-service compatibility, data-flow/control checks and whole-plan cost scoring.
tradeoffs: Client accessibility, security and device behavior still require implementation and testing.

alternatives.why_not: A compatible plan tied on score; the published cost-upper-bound/operated-component/identifier tie-break selected the primary plan, not intrinsic product superiority.

hosting.justification: Matches managed_cloud with provider gcp; no country/region assurance was requested or inferred. Required runtimes and separate database deployment were checked. Selected after supporting-service compatibility, data-flow/control checks and whole-plan cost scoring.
tradeoffs: No workload pricing/SLA is inferred; region, storage, backups, identity and networking require deployment review.
WebSocket clients must handle request timeouts/reconnection and cross-instance state.

alternatives.why_not: More custom integration/operation than this reviewed option.

supporting.justification: Build/test/deploy with pinned dependencies, synthetic fixtures and controlled secrets; production data does not enter the build service.
tradeoffs: Source and synthetic fixtures only; production data, secrets and personal data must never be sent to external build logs. Usage above included minutes is billed.

supporting.justification: Persist edits/photos before transmission; enqueue durable operations with idempotency keys/version checks, retry/backoff and an explicit conflict policy.
tradeoffs: Persist writes before sync; use idempotency keys, versions, conflict policy, resumable photos and network-aware retries. Browser target needs a separate Dexie store.

alternatives.why_not: More custom integration/operation than this reviewed option.

supporting.justification: Private uploads use explicit regional storage, signed access and malware/content validation; preserve upload retries and retention policy. Deploy in the same reviewed compute/data region; explicit configuration is required.
tradeoffs: Choose the same reviewed region, private access, signed URLs and in-region lifecycle/backup policy; do not use a default multi-region bucket.

alternatives.why_not: More custom integration/operation than this reviewed option.

supporting.justification: Authentication method email_password uses a separate Keycloak realm/schema and least-privilege database identity. Deploy in the same reviewed compute/data region; explicit configuration is required.
tradeoffs: Separate realm/schema and restricted database credentials are required; pin supported driver/database versions. Email delivery needs a separately reviewed SMTP integration if enabled.

alternatives.why_not: More custom integration/operation than this reviewed option.

supporting.justification: Collect redacted metrics/logs/traces with regional retention; on cloud use a configured host-provider regional log bucket, locally use provisioned persistent storage. Deploy in the same reviewed compute/data region; explicit configuration is required.
tradeoffs: Redact sensitive values, use host-region retention/routing, and provision a durable regional log backend. No personal data in tracing baggage.

supporting.justification: Application and outbox writes commit atomically; a separately budgeted worker retries idempotently and records dead letters.
tradeoffs: Outbox rows share the database bill. Worker retries must be idempotent; tune polling, retry/dead-letter policy and retention.

summary: modular_monolith recommendation selected from 112 complete compatible plans; month-12 infrastructure planning band USD 148.66–648.37/month.

warnings.message: 99.9% is a target, not a product guarantee. The cost model provisions redundancy assumptions; service terms, failover and workload behavior still require verification.
Upper estimate USD 648.37/month exceeds USD 500; stated usage/price assumptions determine whether it fits.

Planning bands combine published reference rates and explicitly authored allowances; they are not regional provider quotes or measured workload capacity. Validate sizing, merchant/SMS eligibility, storage, requests and current tariffs before purchase.
